brief: Holds several reactors, each an event loop on its own thread, and sends a batch of TCP requests across them at once.
detail: A pool is libuv's multi-loop scaling model: work is round-robined across the loops, each loop multiplexes many connections, and Ring stays synchronous, submitting a batch and then awaiting the answers in order. A handful of loops is plenty for most uses. FetchAll takes a list of [ host, port, payload ] and answers the response texts in the same order. The requests reach the network and were not run for this reference.
